final_answer.key_evidence_summary: In namespace boutique, 10 of 11 deployments are 1/1 AVAILABLE; the single outlier is adservice (deployment 0/1, AVAILABLE 0) with pod adservice-d8d4f4857-4jdhp in 0/1 ErrImagePull. The victim's reachability surface confirms the outage: services/adservice declares 9555/TCP with selector app=adservice, but endpoints/adservice has an empty ENDPOINTS column, so callers (frontend -> adservice) get no serving backend. The mechanism is a bad image reference in the deployment template: GetAppYAML(adservice) shows image 'us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/adservic:v0.10.3' - the repository name 'adservic' is missing the trailing 'e' of 'adservice'. Kubelet events pin the failing stage exactly to the manifest-resolve step, not DNS and not credentials: 'Failed to pull image .../adservic:v0.10.3: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image ... failed to resolve reference .../adservic:v0.10.3: ...: not found', followed by 'Error: ErrImagePull' and 'Back-off pulling image' / 'Error: ImagePullBackOff'. Other surfaces are healthy and exclude alternative branches: the pod is PodScheduled=True on worker-03 (no FailedScheduling for this pod), a ServiceAccount named adservice exists in the same manifest and in the serviceaccounts listing (so the older 'FailedCreate ... serviceaccount adservice not found' and 'FailedScheduling Insufficient cpu' events are setup history), the Service selector matches app=adservice and port 9555 -> targetPort 9555 matches the container port, and probes are grpc on 9555. Hence adservice never starts, its endpoint set is empty, and the failure stays partial - only the ads business unit is unreachable while the other 10 services serve normally.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: adservice
  namespace: boutique 
  labels:
    app: adservice
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: adservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: adservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: adservice
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 5
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/adservic:v0.10.3
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9555
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "9555"
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 180Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 300Mi
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 9555
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 9555
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: adservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: adservice
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: adservice
  ports:
  - name: grpc
    port: 9555
    targetPort: 9555
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: adservice
  namespace: boutique
